comments.content: I think much simpler to check specifically for this use-case. No config found means don't render help menu.

We are trying to have dev and prod apps installed across all orgs so they can interface with all GitHub Actions across our orgs. However only one should respond to user actions and commands, hence why we implemented https://github.com/ubiquity-os/ubiquity-os-kernel/issues/122
For this effect to be complete, the help menu should only render on those with a config (I just deleted the prod config in ubiquity-os-marketplace)
